newsitem.title: USA: Veritas files to offer three mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Veritas files to offer three mln shares.

text.p: Veritas DGC Inc filed Tuesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission a registration to sell up to three million common shares.
After the offering, outstanding shares will total 21,788,940 common, Veritas said in the filing.
Net proceeds will be used for funding of a portion of the company's capital expenditure budget and other general corporate purposes.

The company has granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 450,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Dillon Read & Co Inc, PaineWebber Inc and Raymond James & Associates Inc.
Veritas, based on Houston, Texas, is a provider of seismic data acquisition, data processing and multi-client data surveys to the oil and gas industry in selected markets worldwide.
